name: homelab-dashboard
description: Tailscale-only dashboard for a home server running Jellyfin, a Paper Minecraft server, and Directus/PostgreSQL

scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: node server/test-discover.mjs && node server/test-diskscan.mjs && node server/test-updates.mjs && node server/test-apps.mjs && node server/test-qbittorrent.mjs && node server/test-dns.mjs && node server/test-cf-access.mjs && node server/dist/tools/demo-index.js --check
